verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1652). Loads lib/commerce/fulfilment.ts with its @/ imports stubbed and drives setOrderFulfillment over an in-memory split order of two sellers: a Space marks its share shipped on its own row while the order stays unsent; one seller alone never ships the order; the order reads shipped once both have and closes as fulfilled once both deliver; another Space and the Store door move nothing; an operator moves the one share it names; a single-seller order moves on its own row without reading the transfer ledger. Then checks the Space Shop Orders tab and the maker console no longer render a split order read-only, and the operator page binds a per-share door. Fails on LIVE-624's head (8cf1c86f6) at the first arm. Exits 79 only when the file or its export is gone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1652). Fulfilment of a split order is PER SELLER, on the seller's commerce_order_transfers row: migration 20270345010500 adds fulfillment_status (the same five-step ladder) and fulfilment (carrier, tracking, note, step times). setOrderFulfillment keeps the owner-column path first, so a single-seller order never reads the ledger; when that finds nothing, a Space or a maker is matched to their own transfer row on that order by owner_kind AND that kind's owner id, and moves only it (forward only, compare-and-set on the step read). An operator marks any share by naming its row ({ kind: 'operator', shareId }, setShareFulfillmentAction, one door per share on /admin/marketplace/orders). The order's fulfillment_status rolls up to the least advanced share with something to send, forward only, and a paid order closes as fulfilled once every such share is delivered or complete. The buyer's shipped notice names the seller that shipped and lists their lines only; /orders shows each seller's step under their lines. The Space Shop Orders tab and the maker console open the door on a split order (amends ADR-1616 §3). TESTS: lib/commerce/fulfilment-split.test.ts (per-share writes, roll-up, closing, isolation between sellers, operator by row, notice, single-seller path unchanged, reads) and components/marketplace/split-order-surfaces.test.tsx (one operator door per share).
